predictions.rationale: Represents the Sequence Diagram itself (class name matches feature). Central class controlling creation, persistence, and high-level behavior of interaction/time-ordered diagrams.
Graph model for sequence diagrams; manages the objects (lifelines) and messages laid out on horizontal/vertical axes, directly implementing core semantics.
Responsible for drawing sequence-diagram elements (lifelines, messages, time ordering), aligning with the visual time/object dimensions described.
Factory that builds sequence diagrams; key for creating and initializing the diagram type requested by the feature.
Figure class for messages in a sequence diagram, representing interactions along the time axis; essential visual element for the feature.
Handles activation bars that show object life-time along the vertical (time) dimension of sequence diagrams.
Represents lifeline/object boxes (horizontal dimension) in sequence diagrams, directly supporting the interaction view.
Tool mode enabling users to add messages (time-ordered interactions) in sequence diagrams; supports constructing the feature.
Provides selection handles/behaviors for message figures in sequence diagrams, refining user interaction with time-ordered elements.
Explorer rule linking Interaction elements to their Messages; directly relates to navigating the components of an interaction (sequence) diagram.
